notes: Request and observation timings overlap; do not add them.
Inventory gaps require an explicit Inventory proof, carried only across read-only observe/replay requests. Within-request pause time is excluded; this is a lower bound.
Mission requests include bounded local helper stages and are not a count of model turns or human interventions.
Key events include menu/recovery inputs; combined mount is separate to avoid losing simultaneous input accounting.
Recorded fast-observation total may exclude later vision work; it is not end-to-end capture/vision time.
Unattributed wall time is not automatically productive gameplay or decision time.

World sample spans sum only consecutive world observations within a request, excluding recorded menus/dialogue. They measure sampled exposure/travel/combat time, not useful objective progress, and overlap request time.
